A LITTLE MORE CONTEXT.

Good questions.
Straight answers.

What can I do with YodaX?+

Explore stock forecasts for six US companies, inspect their results, and chat with an AI research assistant about commodities. Each research answer includes a linked evidence map.

Does the research agent predict commodity prices?+

It provides qualitative, conditional outlooks from recent headlines. It does not yet produce validated commodity price targets or change the TimesFM stock forecasts.

How does the model learn from mistakes?+

After actual stock prices arrive, the adaptive layer updates the relative weights of TimesFM, a no-change baseline and a bias-corrected estimate. The original forecasts stay saved, and TimesFM itself is not retrained.

Where does my research come from?+

The agent analyses public news headlines with Gemini Flash-Lite, can investigate a follow-up question, and links its answer to those sources. Headlines are not full-article verification, and the map does not prove causation.

Is this investment advice?+

No. YodaX is an experimental research application. Forecasts can be wrong, and it has not established a trading advantage. Use it to explore questions and evaluate evidence.
